==Background==

The Huaneng Qufu power station was commissioned in September 2006, with construction starting in May 2005. It is located in Qufu, China.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://wikimapia.org/25997324/Power-plant|title=Power plant - Wikimapia|website=wikimapia.org|language=en|access-date=2021-06-01}}</ref> The plant's boiler and steam turbine generator were manufactured by Sichuan Boiler Factory and Beijing Beizhong Turbine Motor Co., Ltd. respectively.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%8D%8E%E8%83%BD%E6%9B%B2%E9%98%9C%E7%94%B5%E5%8E%82|title=华能曲阜电厂|last=|first=|date=|website=Baidu|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=June 1, 2021}}</ref> As the only central heating facility in the city of Qufu, it is responsible for heating the urban area (eight million square meters) and has an annual power generation capacity of 2.4 billion kilowatt-hours (kWh).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ynpxrz.com/n2130701c1277.aspx|title=华能曲阜电厂2021年应届毕业生校园招聘启事_易贤网|last=|first=|date=October 11, 2020|website=www.ynpxrz.com|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-06-01}}</ref> As of September 2020, it has generated 33.4 billion kWh of electricity and 17.95 million GJ of heating.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ynpxrz.com/n2130701c1277.aspx|title=华能曲阜电厂2021年应届毕业生校园招聘启事_易贤网|last=|first=|date=October 11, 2020|website=www.ynpxrz.com|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-06-01}}</ref>

In February 2020, at the start of the coronavirus pandemic, coal stocks fell, creating a shortage in coal. The owners of the Huaneng Qufu power plant asked the government for aid with the delivery of new. The Qufu Transportation Bureau immediately opened a so-called 'green channel' for the Huaneng Power Plant, which ensured the smooth passage for the 15 transportation vehicles carrying coal to the facility.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sohu.com/a/372073921_118392|title=山东曲阜“绿色通道”让企业生产无后顾之忧_运输|last=|first=|date=2020-02-11|website=Sohu News|language=en|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-06-01}}</ref>
